(schema)  version=0
    markdown: "Coralogix archive-retention. For more info please review - https://coralogix.com/docs/archive-setup-grpc-api/."
id  StringAttribute computed
    default: stringdefault.staticStringDefault value defaults to archive-retention-settings
    markdown: "The fixed id of this singleton: there is one per company."
retentions  ListNestedAttribute required
    markdown: "List of 4 retentions. The first retention is the default retention and can't be renamed."
retentions[]  NestedObject
retentions[].editable  BoolAttribute computed
    markdown: "Is the retention editable."
retentions[].id  StringAttribute computed
    markdown: "The retention id."
    plan modifier: stringplanmodifier.useStateForUnknownModifier Once set, the value of this attribute in state will not change.
retentions[].name  StringAttribute optional computed
    markdown: "The retention name. If not set, the retention will be named by backend."
retentions[].order  Int64Attribute computed
    markdown: "The retention order. Computed by the order of the retention in the retentions list definition."
